story.so_that: I can run agentic workflow Activities with the capabilities and safeguards appropriate to each task, with 100% of automated resolution cases and representative configured Story Analysis invocations using the expected settings without permission-related artifact failures
story.as_a: Software Engineer and AI Process Designer
story.i_want: to configure default and per-skill Devin models and tool permissions for each Skill Activity invocation

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Profiles independently select the Devin model and a supported permission mode.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a resolved profile selects model M and supported permission mode P When DevinHarness constructs the subprocess command Then --model is followed by M and --permission-mode is followed by P as separate arguments

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: A partial skill override replaces only specified fields and inherits all unspecified fields from defaults.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given defaults specify model SWE-1.7 and permission_mode auto and analyze-story overrides only permission_mode with accept-edits When analyze-story is resolved Then its model is SWE-1.7 and permission mode is accept-edits

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: The default permission mode is auto and unrestricted modes are used only through explicit configuration.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given permission_mode is omitted from defaults When the default profile is created Then permission mode is auto and neither dangerous nor bypass is selected

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: An unattended artifact-producing skill must explicitly resolve to accept-edits or another explicitly selected mode that permits its required writes.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given analyze-story has an explicit accept-edits override When it creates its analysis and sentinel files non-interactively Then both writes complete without an approval prompt

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: A restricted skill is never automatically promoted to a broader permission mode.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a skill resolves to auto When it attempts a write requiring confirmation Then the invocation remains auto and reports the harness or missing-artifact failure without retrying under accept-edits, dangerous, or bypass

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Invalid known settings fail before the Devin subprocess starts and identify the affected skill and setting.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given analyze-story sets permission_mode to unsupported-mode When configuration is validated Then the subprocess runner is not called and the error identifies analyze-story and permission_mode

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Explicit null, empty, or wrong-typed known values are invalid rather than treated as inheritance.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a skill override explicitly sets model to an empty string When configuration is validated Then the subprocess runner is not called and the error identifies that skill and model

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unknown top-level and profile keys are ignored without changing known-field resolution.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given valid defaults include an unknown future key and a skill override includes another unknown key When the profile is resolved Then known model and permission_mode values resolve normally and the unknown keys do not reach the Devin command

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Legacy flat model and permission_mode values map to the new defaults without changing effective behavior.
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the existing flat configuration specifies model SWE-1.7 and permission_mode auto When it is loaded Then the effective defaults are model SWE-1.7 and permission mode is auto and no migration error occurs

related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given devin_harness.config.json does not exist When a profile is resolved Then model SWE-1.7 and permission mode auto are used
Given devin_harness.config.json is not valid JSON When it is loaded Then no Devin subprocess starts and the configuration path is reported
Given defaults or skills is not an object When configuration is validated Then no subprocess starts and the invalid container is reported

related_edge_cases.criterion: Worker cannot read the configuration file
related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given the worker lacks read permission for devin_harness.config.json When configuration is loaded Then no subprocess starts and a sanitized configuration-read error is reported

related_edge_cases.criterion: Default auto mode cannot authorize a required unattended write
related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given an artifact-producing skill has no accept-edits override and resolves to auto When it attempts to write Then permissions are not broadened and the Activity reports failure rather than success

related_edge_cases.criterion: Devin subprocess exits nonzero or cannot be started
related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given the configured Devin process exits nonzero or executable startup fails When the Activity invokes it Then the Activity reports failure and does not report a successful artifact

dependencies: docs/reqs/skill-activity-configs/streams/foundations.stream.json: frozen profile/configuration contracts and invocation context accessor

steps.description: Implement strict loading and normalization for missing-file, structured, mixed structured/legacy, and legacy-flat configuration, ignoring unknown keys but rejecting invalid known structures and values.
Implement field-level effective profile resolution by canonical skill name with precedence skill override, structured default, legacy default, then SWE-1.7/auto.
Build each list-valued Devin CLI command from a fresh immutable effective profile and preserve the original mode across all failure paths without escalation.
Migrate the colocated example configuration to defaults and canonical Story Analysis skill overrides with explicit accept-edits for unattended artifact producers.
Add focused parser, resolver, command, validation, compatibility, and no-escalation unit tests.
